properties.description: Bulk forms for every tool BL-153's surface measurement caught calling itself: create_nodes, create_edges, set_artifact_checksums, acknowledge_gaps, gaps_to_prompts. 52.9% of all tool-to-tool transitions across 46 sessions and 6,095 calls were self-loops; these answer set_artifact_checksum 244, create_node 112, contains 109, acknowledge_gap 90, gap_to_prompt 83, contain_component 77 and satisfies 74. create_edges is ONE tool rather than six because contains/contain_component/satisfies/allocate/realizes are thin wrappers that only fill in the endpoint types, and BL-155's 40-never-called count makes near-identical tools a cost. Every form is all-or-nothing WITH per-item findings, and every form that records a judgement keeps that judgement per item.
